description:
New files only — schema + parser + tests; no warp, store, grade or UI
integration (the integrator's wave).

app/src/main/java/com/ritim/ritimcraw/data/lens/LensProfile.kt:
- the pure model: LensProfile (version/name/source/identity/intrinsics/
  distortion/modes), LensIdentity, LensIntrinsics, LensDistortion,
  LensStabMode, LensProfileError
- binding key derived from the REAL container fields: the
  MetadataBuilder.mcrawCamera fallback chain (uniqueCameraModel ->
  deviceModel -> "manufacturer buildModel" -> buildModel ->
  manufacturer) + the 35mm-equivalent focal rounded to 0.1 mm + the
  aperture when carried; the container's float noise (23.9501972...)
  must not split one lens into two keys, real lenses sit far apart
